title: Choose the Dossier page's world
question: The roll assigned The Case File. Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll. (Confirming too: the reader is you, right after a run; the job is triage then hand-off; one offline HTML file per run.)

options.label: The Case File
options.lineage: Agency case files: tabbed folders, ruled index sheets, exhibit tags, adjudication stamps
options.thesis: Every finding already stood before a tribunal; the page is the file it left behind.
options.viewport: The folder opens on its index sheet: run, target and seats typed into ruled fields, a tabbed P1/P2/P3 spine down the left edge, and the first exhibit open with its claim on the left and the code evidence clipped beside it.
options.risk: Tips into spy-movie costume the moment a stamp or a paper texture is decoration instead of state.

raised.raise: State is a mark, not a hue: an initialled check stamp for reviewed, a tape flag where you stopped, refuted and dropped items hung in a 'set aside' sleeve at the back.
Priority reads as stamp size on a fixed three-step ramp, so it survives without colour.
Exhibit annotations pin to the exact code line on a leader line.
One ruled neutral ramp is the only tonal scale; colour appears only as adjudication ink.
Each exhibit leads with one imperative line, what to do, before the argument.

options.label: The Proof Galley
options.lineage: Copy editors' marked galley proofs and Tufte sidenotes
options.thesis: The changed code is the page; the findings are the editor's marks in its margin.
options.viewport: A long galley of each touched hunk down the centre, findings set as numbered margin notes level with their lines.
options.risk: Familiar: it is where review tools land when they go upmarket, and it reads thin for findings that are about structure rather than one line.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.lineage: Film editor's select rail and trim bin
options.thesis: Findings strung as frames on a rail; triage is marking frames, not reading a list.
options.viewport: A perforated rail across the top with one frame per finding; the open frame's claim and evidence fill the window below.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for triage state; loses on audience, since an engineer doesn't live at a cutting bench.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Findings plotted as stars, priority as magnitude.
options.viewport: A chart of the change with findings as stars over files.
options.case: Reading a claim on a sky chart costs clarity, and the audience doesn't recognize itself.
options.kept: Priority as size on a fixed ramp.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.viewport: A force diagram of the change.
options.kept: Annotations pinned to their node on leader lines.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Findings as hatched regions over a zone ramp.
options.case: Hatching as priority is unreadable for prose claims.
options.kept: One tonal ramp as the only neutral tokens.

options.label: Park Poster
options.viewport: Each finding as a poster plane.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One pull shapes the flat plane.
options.viewport: A flat claim that gathers into evidence.
options.kept: One control opens the full evidence.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: GitHub's Files changed review, executed impeccably: file tree, diff, inline comments.
canonCard.viewport: File tree left, diff centre, findings as inline review comments.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from GitHub by design, and Judgment findings that are not about one line have nowhere to sit.
